title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description: ABOUT ABDUL LATIF JAMEEL Abdul Latif Jameel… a place to realize your potential. Through Respect, Continuous Improvement, Pioneering Spirit, and Empowerment, we are proud of our culture which sees ideas blossom, people thrive and success flourish. Abdul Latif Jameel is a global investor and 80-year-old network of internationally diversified businesses shaping the future of core sectors driving the global economy including, Mobility, Energy, Environmental Services, Financial Services and Health; together with land & real estate development, logistics, electronics retailing and media services. Established in 1945 Abdul Latif Jameel has a presence in more than 35 countries employing over 11,000 people from more than 85 nationalities. About The Role(open to Turkiye, India, Egypt) Design, build, integrate and operate secure, scalable web applications and digital services for ALJ businesses. The role combines hands-on front-end and back-end coding with system design, API integration, cloud deployment and production ownership, while creating reusable engineering patterns that support ALJ's enterprise architecture and digital delivery standards. Key Accountabilities & KPIs • Deliver end-to-end web applications, APIs and integrations. • Own technical design and produce maintainable production code. • Engineer secure, resilient and observable services. • Integrate ALJ enterprise platforms and external services. • Improve engineering automation and delivery discipline. • Collaborate with architecture, security, data and business teams. • Quality releases delivered to agreed scope; low escaped defects; stakeholder acceptance. • Architecture / code review compliance; reduced technical debt; reusable components. • Security findings resolved; availability, latency and incident targets achieved. • Reliable interfaces; documented APIs; successful end-to-end processing. • Automated test coverage, CI/CD adoption and shorter release lead time. • Timely decisions, clear documentation and effective stakeholder feedback. Major Activities: Design responsive web applications using React or Angular and TypeScript. Develop backend services using Node.js, Java / Spring Boot, .NET or Python, according to the approved solution stack. Design REST APIs, microservices and event-driven integrations with appropriate versioning and error handling. Model and optimize relational and NoSQL data stores; ensure data integrity and performance. Integrate with ERP, CRM, identity, collaboration, data and third-party platforms used across ALJ. Apply OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, Microsoft Entra ID, secrets management and secure coding practices. Create automated unit, integration, API and end-to-end tests. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, Docker containers and cloud deployment configurations. Implement logging, tracing, metrics, alerting and operational dashboards. Participate in architecture, security, code quality and production-readiness reviews. Troubleshoot production incidents and perform root-cause analysis and corrective action. Coach engineers and contribute reusable standards, reference implementations and technical documentation. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent strong professional experience. 6-10 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 3 years delivering full-stack, cloud-hosted applications and enterprise integrations in production. Advanced JavaScript / TypeScript and React or Angular. Strong backend engineering in Node.js, Java / Spring Boot, .NET or Python. REST APIs, microservices, event-driven design and enterprise integration. SQL and NoSQL databases; data modelling and performance optimization. Azure and/or AWS; Docker; CI/CD; working knowledge of Kubernetes. Git-based development, automated testing, observability and production support. System design, HLD / LLD documentation and secure software development. Fluent professional English; ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to business and technology stakeholders. Cloud developer / architect certification from Microsoft Azure or AWS is preferred. Kubernetes, security or relevant framework certification is advantageous but not mandatory. A note from the hiring manager: We are building a senior AI engineering capability in India to design and deliver production-grade Generative AI and agentic solutions used across an international business. You will work on real AI products involving LLMs, RAG, agents, enterprise data and APIs, with direct influence over architecture and technology choices. We have an exciting roadmap to train our own LLMs using open weight LLMs and deploy them into countries where data sovereignty requirements demand so. If you are someone who enjoys serious research whilst also delivering production grade solutions for low-latency real-time AI solutions, come speak to us. You will contribute to our overall Architecture You will work on real-time AI solutions with high concurrency and on multiple production deployments in multiple countries You will be working on research on latest and coolest AI technologies - to recommend what is good for ALJ You will be working on training our own Models that will be deployed in production systems Plus you may get to meet some cool people selling some of the best automobiles in the world WHY JOIN ABDUL LATIF JAMEEL Set up business from ground. Be part of a globally respected, family-owned organization with 80 years of pioneering history. Work across diverse cultures and geographies with real international exposure Join a people-first culture built on Respect, Continuous Improvement, Pioneering Spirit, and Empowerment READY TO MAKE YOUR MARK? If you are ready to grow, contribute, and realize your potential within one of the region's most respected organizations — we would love to hear from you. Apply now!

title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend / Full-Stack)
description: About Kopilot Kopilot is redefining how millions of students prepare for exams through AI-powered learning, personalized coaching, and viral social growth. Recently named “EdTech Startup of the Year,” Kopilot is building a next-generation education super app where students can learn, solve questions, join communities, get coaching, and have fun — all in one place. Our platform combines AI, data, and human coaching to create one of the fastest-growing education products in the region, and we are now preparing for global expansion. We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer , reporting to the Head of Technology, who will play a key role in scaling our platform and evolving our system architecture as our product and user base grow rapidly. Role Overview As a Senior Software Engineer at Kopilot, you will help design and build scalable systems used by thousands of students every day. This role is backend-focused with full-stack capabilities. You will contribute to critical architectural decisions, improve system reliability and performance, and help evolve our platform toward a scalable architecture. You will collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver high-quality features quickly while maintaining strong engineering standards. Responsibilities System Transformation: Execute the migration of core business logic from a prototype environment to a structured NestJS & TypeScript backend. Architecture Implementation: Work within a Modular Monolith strategy to build clean, maintainable, and "ready-to-microservice" system components. Database Optimization: Design and maintain the data layer on PostgreSQL, ensuring data integrity and performance. Infrastructure Execution: Implement the Cloud Native roadmap, managing containerization (Docker) and modern CI/CD workflows. Quality & Standards: Maintain system stability through automated testing, clear documentation, and adherence to established engineering rules. Velocity & AI: Use AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) to maximize engineering velocity and automate repetitive tasks without compromising code quality. Requirements 7–10 years of software engineering experience (Open to 5+ years for candidates with strong startup scale-up or migration experience). Strong backend experience with Node.js, TypeScript, and NestJS. Solid understanding of RDBMS (PostgreSQL) and data integrity. Experience with Clean Architecture or Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles. Familiarity with Cloud Native concepts (Docker and modern deployment workflows). Full-Stack capability (React or React Native) to support our unified product experience. Execution Mindset: A "builder" mentality focused on turning architectural designs into stable, production-ready reality. Hybrid-Ready: Ability to attend occasional in-person team meetups in Istanbul (approx. 3-4 times per month) while working primarily remote. Nice to Have Experience working in Edtech apps. Experience scaling high-growth startup products. Experience with cloud infrastructure and modern DevOps practices. Experience with AI-assisted development tools. Experience with React Native or mobile-first products. Why Kopilot? Build a category-defining EdTech super app. Work on products used by thousands of students every day. Join one of the fastest-growing startups in Turkey. Play a key role in shaping the architecture and engineering culture of the company. Be part of a global expansion journey. Work in a fast-moving startup environment with high ownership. Remote-first hybrid model — work from anywhere most of the time, with 3–4 in-person team meetups per month in our Istanbul office.
